proposals.title: PROPOSAL 5: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL ON WHETHER TO ALLOW STOCKHOLDERS TO ACT BY WRITTEN CONSENT
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders to act by written consent with the minimum votes needed to authorize action at a fully attended meeting.

proposals.title: PROPOSAL 6: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REQUESTING A REPORT ON THE GLOBAL MEDIAN GENDER/RACIAL PAY GAP
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Shana Weiss and John Silva
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on Intel's global median gender/racial pay gap and associated policy, reputational, competitive, operational and talent risks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this proposal requesting the preparation of a report on Intel's global median gender/racial pay gap
